versions.changelog:
Photo Archive Curator 1.0.0 — Initial release for offline photo archive cleanup and organization.

- Detects exact and near-duplicate photos, blurry candidates, and burst series with keeper recommendations.
- Organizes photos into dated folders using EXIF timestamps, with a marked mtime fallback and collision-safe names.
- Defaults to dry-run; near-duplicates can be quarantined, and deletion requires explicit approval.
- Handles photo sidecars and provides scan-and-review guidance before changes are applied.
